nodes.title: Debris, bananas, first serve
nodes.text: Ace, Riff, and Scorch freeze the explosion mid-air. Tennis whites. Denim vest. A purple hat with a banana plume. The English 10 board is still due. High learning. High silliness. Last point still counts.

choices.label: Pull a tool from the loadout

nodes.title: The board is a comic page
nodes.text: Summer strips. Empty boxes. Scorch taps a blank panel with the sax. A picture with no beat is just a poster. The real assignment is still the summer comic — finish the pages you started.

school.prompt: What does a comic panel need besides pictures?

options.label: Words, speech, or a story beat
A finished novel in the margin

nodes.title: Burned. Not out.
nodes.text: Scorch shrugs the tattered jacket back on. Wrong swing. Not shame. You get the ball back. A panel still needs more than drawings — words, a beat, something the reader can hear.

nodes.title: First serve
nodes.text: Ace steps wide. Green headband. One clean toss. The first serve is a start, not the whole match — same as the names video, same as one unfinished strip. You do not have to finish the novel tonight.

choices.label: Hold the rally and walk off

nodes.title: Notebook of Holding
nodes.text: The spiral is bigger on the inside. Index cards. A highlighter. Friday-you will not hunt lockers. Finish what you start — one page, then the next. Not a semester in one sitting.

choices.label: Carry it to the comic board
Pack it and call the rally

nodes.title: Rally held
nodes.text: Rock hangs in the air. The city is a silhouette. Ace, Riff, and Scorch are still standing. School work and the story are the same game. Come back when the next strip is due.

choices.label: Read it again from the top
